text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Dedicated pool 'lighthouse-enterprise-vpc' GPU utilization at 98% — single tenant 'lighthouse-corp' is consuming ~92% of pool. Queues increasing, 504s reported. Paging oncall.

oliver (oncall): acked. looking at dashboards. pulling logs.

sophie (sre): I see sustained queueing for the tenant — queued requests ~420, tail latency spiking. Link: https://dash.redwood/lighthouse-enterprise-vpc/overview

tara (csm): fyi Lighthouse ops just started multi-hour batch exports this morning. They're enterprise SLA but these jobs are non-critical. I'm pinging them to pause.

kevin (infra): quick diag: autoscaler didn't add GPUs because pool is tenant-pinned with burst disabled. config snippet: 

```
$ ri pool describe lighthouse-enterprise-vpc
capacity_gpus: 10
alloc_gpus: 10
burst_enabled: false
queued_requests: 420
avg_latency: 1.8s
```

kevin (infra): we have spare capacity in shared-spare-pool but enabling burst requires cost-owner approval for >$200/hr. For incident response we can request a 2h override.

raj (platform-eng): proposal: enable a temporary burst (+4 GPUs), apply workload throttling to heavy embedding/batch routes, and switch non-interactive jobs to fallback smaller model. That should reduce queueing asap.

oliver (oncall): plan summary: (1) request cost approval, (2) enable burst +4 for 2h, (3) set routing throttle to 70% for batch embeddings, (4) ask customer to pause long-running jobs, (5) monitor 10m and re-evaluate. If no improvement, consider graceful eviction order but avoid unless SLA prohibits.

tara (csm): I've messaged Lighthouse ops: "@lighthouse-ops can you pause batch exports?" — they're responding: "pausing now, ETA 3m" :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

jamie (finance): I'm finance oncall — for emergency incident triage I approve up to +4 GPUs for 2 hours under cost center LGT-OPS. Approve: jamie (finance) :white_check_mark: 

kevin (infra): enabling burst now. executing: 

```
$ ri pool burst enable lighthouse-enterprise-vpc --add-gpus 4 --duration 2h
OK -> burst_id=b-8932
```

kevin (infra): note: billing will reflect temporary usage under LGT-OPS. Recording burst_id for audit.

sophie (sre): monitoring metrics — 2 minutes after enable: queued requests -> 210, avg latency -> 900ms (was 1.8s). Good trend.

oliver (oncall): applying routing throttle and model fallback now. Commands: 

```
ri routing update --pool lighthouse-enterprise-vpc --route batch-embeddings --throttle 70
ri routing update --pool lighthouse-enterprise-vpc --fallback-model batch -> redwood-small-v2
```

raj (platform-eng): added a temporary rule to deprioritize long tail requests from the tenant: priority=low for exports. Also queued a background job to drain large KV caches to free memory.

sophie (sre): 10m check: queued requests -> 40, avg latency -> 620ms, 5xxs down to normal. Burst holding steady.

tara (csm): Lighthouse ops confirmed batch pause and says they'll keep an eye and resume once we tell them. They appreciate the quick response.

oliver (oncall): creating incident ticket: INCIDENT-4187654321 created, sev=P1 (customer impact, but degraded only). Notes: dedicated pool exhausted by single-tenant batch jobs; temporary burst +4 enabled, routing throttles applied, customer paused jobs. Post-incident actions: (a) discuss pool sizing/reservation vs. tenant isolation policy, (b) consider automatic burst-enablement for pinned tenants under emergency path, (c) add cost owner on-call escalation doc.

jamie (finance): confirm cost center LGT-OPS charged for burst window b-8932. Approve post-incident review to determine whether recurring commit adjustment needed.

kevin (infra): I'll leave burst enabled for 2h as authorized. scheduling automatic rollback at 2h mark unless ops requests extension.

raj (platform-eng): also scheduling a follow-up to evaluate autoscaler logic for tenant-pinned pools — current logic prevents scale-on-demand; propose a safe emergency override path.

oliver (oncall): handing over active monitoring to sophie; my shift ends in 25m. Sophie — take the pager and the ticket.

sophie (sre): taking over. I'll keep monitoring for the next hour and coordinate the rollback. Adding notes to INCIDENT-4187654321.

incident-bot: RESOLVE CHECK: after 20m of stable metrics we can de-escalate to post-incident review. Current status: stable.

oliver (oncall): thanks team. Closing realtime response. Postmortem owner: raj (platform-eng). CSM follow-up: tara.

sophie (sre): adding quick runbook entry: "If tenant exhausts dedicated pool: 1) check burst_enabled, 2) request cost approval, 3) enable burst, 4) apply throttle, 5) contact customer to pause heavy jobs." Will PR to runbooks repo.

tara (csm): I'll email Lighthouse with summary and ask for confirmation before we close incident.

end of thread.
